assumptions: Static bracket. Four box collision proxies preserve the through-channel; no material strength model.
blender_script:
def build(params, api):
    w = params['width_m']
    d = params['depth_m']
    h = params['height_m']
    t = params['wall_m']
    outer = api.box('outer', [w, d, h])
    cutter = api.box('channel', [w-2*t, d+0.02, h-2*t])
    api.difference(outer, cutter)
    api.body('root', [outer], [0,0,0], [
        {'type':'box','size':[t/2,d/2,h/2],'pos':[-w/2+t/2,0,0]},
        {'type':'box','size':[t/2,d/2,h/2],'pos':[w/2-t/2,0,0]},
        {'type':'box','size':[w/2-t,d/2,t/2],'pos':[0,0,h/2-t/2]},
        {'type':'box','size':[w/2-t,d/2,t/2],'pos':[0,0,-h/2+t/2]}])
    api.clearance_probe('root', [0,0,0])
